Portfolio review –
Akiira Geothermal
Business highlights and progress
▪ Akiira Geothermal is strategically well-placed to provide base load power
to the grid and captive consumers to capture the significant and growing
demand for green energy in Kenya and beyond.
▪ To drive value creation and maximise the existing market opportunity,
Centum increased its stake in the project from 37.5% to 75%.
▪ The project has secured an extension of the power purchase agreement
(PPA) and geothermal license.
Investor engagement
▪ We are in talks with a number of investors to enable us to close the
equity round for the development of a 140MW power plant.
